summary: End-to-end verification of SaveFlex SEO + history + Monetag + proxy-download features. Backend 8/8 pytest passed. Frontend SEO (title, canonical, JSON-LD) verified across all 6 pages, Download History localStorage flow works (seed -> render -> clear), Monetag script tag injected, mobile viewport renders. No blocking issues.
critical_code_review_comments: SEO.jsx: title/desc are updated dynamically but on unmount only JSON-LD scripts are removed; meta tags persist (acceptable - next page overwrites them). No issue.
useDownloadHistory.js: localStorage key 'saveflex_download_history' confirmed, MAX_ITEMS=20 cap working. Storage event listener handles cross-tab sync correctly.
server.py /api/proxy-download: filename sanitization via regex [^\w\s\-\.] strips path-traversal chars; empty-after-sanitize falls back to 'video.mp4'. Good.
server.py: HEAD request before streaming may fail for sources that disallow HEAD; in that case the exception is caught and a 502 is returned - acceptable but consider falling back to GET headers.
Monetag script: loaded inline in index.html and visible in DOM. No CSP blocks observed in console.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all SEO + history + Monetag + mobile checks passed)

seed_data_creation: Seeded localStorage 'saveflex_download_history' with 3 sample entries on homepage for history rendering test; cleared after assertions.
